# 2010–2015: Finding Cindi and the Architecture of Second Marriage

The Plenty of Fish profile was an act of courage disguised as an online form. Bob had resisted online dating for years, suspicious of its mechanisms, uncomfortable with the self-promotional aspect of crafting an appealing profile. But the alternative—waiting for chance encounters or relying on the limited social circles of widowerhood—was not producing results.
